name: JARVIS Brain
description: Inspect and tune the local JARVIS/Ollama brain from natural-language conversations.
progressive_guidance: Use these tools when the owner asks about JARVIS performance, current model, RAM/VRAM pressure, benchmark, ECO/NORMAL/BOOST modes, model switching or unloading. Read-only status and benchmark are automatic. Model/mode/unload changes require the JARVIS one-time approval policy. Do not bypass the policy with shell commands.
